Nadia Khoury  
📍 Austin, TX | 📞 +1 (555) 123-4567 | 📧 nadia.khoury@email.com | linkedin.com/in/nadia-khoury  

As a backend engineer at RetailFlow Technologies, I’ve focused on building scalable systems that support high-traffic e-commerce platforms. My work has centered on optimizing infrastructure, refining data workflows, and ensuring seamless integration between microservices. Over the past two years, I’ve contributed to deploying solutions that handle millions of transactions monthly, with a particular emphasis on improving database efficiency and containerized deployment processes.  

In my first year, I transitioned from an intern to a junior developer by assisting in the development of core backend services. This involved designing REST APIs for product catalog management, which reduced API response latency by 30% through optimized query structures. I also supported the migration of legacy systems to PostgreSQL, where I implemented indexing strategies that scaled database query performance by 40% during peak hours. Later, I took ownership of deploying microservices using Docker, which streamlined the CI/CD pipeline and cut deployment times by 25%.  

Currently, I specialize in maintaining AWS-based infrastructure, where I’ve configured auto-scaling groups and managed cost optimization for compute resources. My work with Docker has extended to orchestrating multi-container applications, ensuring consistent environments across development and production. I’ve also collaborated on monitoring tools that track system health, enabling proactive alerts for potential bottlenecks.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Designed scalable compute architectures, implemented auto-scaling for EC2 instances, and optimized S3 storage costs by 15% through lifecycle policies.  
- **Docker**: Containerized microservices, reduced dependency conflicts by standardizing base images, and improved deployment reliability.  
- **Microservices Architecture**: Built modular services for order processing, which improved system resilience by isolating fault domains.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Engineered database schemas for real-time analytics, achieving 99.9% query reliability during Black Friday traffic spikes.  
- **Python**: Automated testing frameworks that cut regression bug resolution time by 35% through unit test coverage.  
- **REST API Design**: Developed endpoints for inventory management, which integrated with third-party logistics systems to reduce order fulfillment delays by 20%.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Integrated GitHub Actions into the deployment workflow, ensuring code changes pass automated tests before reaching production.  
- **Linux Administration**: Configured Ubuntu servers for production environments, ensuring secure SSH access and regular system updates.  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Set up Prometheus and Grafana dashboards to track service uptime, reducing unplanned downtime by 40%.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Cairo University (2022)

- **Order Processing System**: Led the development of a microservices-based platform that handles 10,000+ orders per minute, using Kafka for event streaming and Redis for caching.  
- **Database Optimization Initiative**: Redesigned sharding strategies for PostgreSQL to support global user access, improving read performance by 50% during regional traffic surges.
